name: ezamowienia-tenders-mcp-server
stderr:
[ezamowienia-tenders-mcp-server] Missing APIFY_API_TOKEN.
This bridge forwards requests to the hosted Polish Public Tenders (e-Zamówienia/BZP) MCP Actor on Apify,
which bills your Apify account per call. Set your own token:

  "env": { "APIFY_API_TOKEN": "apify_api_..." }

Get a token (and access to the Actor) from the Apify Store page in the README.
